boundary: Simulation-only diagnostic; this setting is not a hardware configuration or acceptance.

official_wuji_assembly_policy.semantics: Official model-specific internal assembly-overlap exclusions; no cross-digit, distal/palm, cross-hand, arm or table pair is removed.
official_wuji_assembly_policy.boundary: Excluded assembly mesh intersections remain geometric overlaps and must not be described as zero all-mesh penetration.

wrist_distance_feedback.mode: simulation-only bounded q_command residual; nominal q_target and qdot are retained

arm_force_drive_rnea_feedforward.mode: arm-only force-drive position bias: delta_q = RNEA torque / runtime force-drive stiffness; no direct external effort command
arm_force_drive_rnea_feedforward.force_drive_units: Nm for drive stiffness times rad position bias

initial_state_semantics: reference q with zero velocity followed by 240 settling steps (0.500000000s)
position_command_semantics: nominal q_target with nominal qdot velocity target; no command bias
measured_effort_semantics: solver-computed joint effort; not a hardware torque or acceptance claim
